bodies.en:
About us

This is a demonstration website built with pacod-cms, an open-source content management system for organisations that run one or many websites.

Everything you see here — the articles, the categories, this page — is sample content. Replace it in the studio: open Pages, pick this page and write your own story.

What we publish

  • News and short updates
  • In-depth features and guides
  • Interviews and opinion pieces
bodies.de:
Über uns

Dies ist eine Demonstrations-Website, erstellt mit pacod-cms, einem quelloffenen Content-Management-System für Organisationen mit einer oder vielen Websites.

Alles, was Sie hier sehen — die Artikel, die Kategorien, diese Seite — ist Beispielinhalt. Ersetzen Sie ihn im Studio: Öffnen Sie Seiten, wählen Sie diese Seite und schreiben Sie Ihre eigene Geschichte.

descriptions.en: Banner formats and how to book them.

bodies.en:
Advertise with us

This website carries image and HTML5 banners in three formats:

  • Leaderboard — 728×90, above the content
  • Rectangle — 300×250, in the side column
  • Half page — 300×600, in the side column

Bookings can be limited to particular page types and to a start and end date. Write to ads@example.com.

descriptions.en: What this website records about its readers, and why.

bodies.en:
Privacy policy

This is placeholder text, not legal advice. Replace it with a policy written for your organisation before publishing your website.

pacod-cms itself sets one cookie on the public website, lang, which remembers the language a reader chose. Reader statistics are counted without cookies: a salted, truncated hash of the address and browser identifies a reader for one day, and no address is stored.

Any analytics or advertising service you enable in the site settings sets cookies of its own and needs to be described here.
